h: Orpington High Street at a glance
p: Orpington's High Street runs north to south through the town, with the Walnuts shopping centre roughly in the middle, so Bensons is easy to fold into a trip round the shops. Orpington station is a little way to the west of the High Street and has fast trains into central London, which is why the town is so popular with commuters.

If you're looking for something to do nearby, Priory Gardens, by the old Orpington Priory, is a peaceful green space just off the High Street. A short drive away, Chislehurst Caves offer guided lamp-lit tours of the old chalk tunnels, and High Elms Country Park has woodland walks and a nature centre.
Bensons is an adult gaming centre, so it's over-18s only, and staff may ask for ID if you look under 25.
